setup.zh: 马三来收租，全村都来看：一张完整的鹿皮，二十斤肉。马三眯起眼睛：「黑松岭……里头还有什么？」
setup.en: Ma San comes for the rent and the whole village comes to watch: a whole deer hide, twenty jin of meat. Ma San narrows his eyes: "Black Pine Ridge… what else is in there?"

recap.zh: 租交上了，弓保住了；马三问黑松岭里有什么；娘摸了摸你的"围脖"，什么都没问。
recap.en: The rent was paid and the bow kept; Ma San asked what was inside Black Pine Ridge; Mother touched your "scarf" and asked nothing.

zh: 一张完整的鹿皮，油光水滑。
en: A whole deer hide, sleek and glossy.
Twenty jin of meat, not an ounce short.

story.zh:
马三来收租那天，半个村子的人都来看。

一张鹿皮，油光水滑。二十斤肉，只多不少。

马三拎起鹿皮抖了抖，翻过来看了看，又翻回去看了看，脸上的横肉一跳一跳的，像一锅烧开了的红烧肉。

**马三**：黑松岭？

**爹**：（老老实实）黑松岭。

**马三**：进去了……还出来了？（眯起眼）里头，还有什么？
story.en:
The day Ma San comes for the rent, half the village turns out to watch.

One deer hide, sleek and glossy. Twenty jin of meat, not an ounce short.

Ma San picks up the hide and shakes it, turns it over and looks, turns it back and looks again, the thick meat of his face twitching and jumping like a pot of braised pork on the boil.

**Ma San:** Black Pine Ridge?

**Father:** (honest as ever) Black Pine Ridge.

**Ma San:** Went in… and came back out? (narrowing his eyes) What else is in there?

label.zh: 踩爹的脚后跟，抢着装傻
label.en: Tread on Father's heel and play the fool

exits.means: plays dumb, says there is nothing in there, scared, hides what they saw

story.zh:
你爹张嘴就要说。

你在后面，轻轻踩了一下他的脚后跟。

**你**：（抢着说，缩着脖子，抖得像一片树叶）三爷！里头……里头黑乎乎的，下大雨，我掉沟里了，差点就死了！还有鬼！有个白衣服的，没有脚，飘着走，冲我笑——三爷，那地方真不能去，我爷爷就是在那儿没的！

**马三**：……白衣服的？

**你**：还吃饼！

**马三**：鬼吃饼？

**你**：吃得可香了！

马三盯着你看了半天。你继续抖。抖得很专业，从头抖到脚，连头发丝都在配合。

马三哼了一声，把鹿皮扔给了身后的家丁。

马小宝在他爹身后，冲你挤眼睛：「哟，还活着呢？命挺硬啊。」

**你**：（低头）托小宝哥的福。

马小宝很满意。

你也很满意。

---

马家的人走了以后，你娘把你拉进屋，关上门——门已经从{伴}家菜地里扛回来了，装得有点歪。

她看着你。看了很久。

**娘**：你刚才踩你爹那一下。娘看见了。

**你**：……

**娘**：还有那个白衣服、没有脚、吃饼的鬼。

**你**：……娘，那是我编的。

**娘**：嗯。编得不好。（顿了顿）鬼不吃饼。下回说它吃香火。

她伸出手，替你把脖子上那条"狐皮围脖"理了理。

你愣住了。

围脖里那只昏迷的小狐狸，耳朵，轻轻动了一下。

**娘**：这条围脖，挺暖和的吧。

她什么都没问，转身去灶间了。
story.en:
Your father opens his mouth to answer.

Behind him, you tread lightly on his heel.

**You:** (cutting in, hunching your shoulders, shaking like a leaf) Third Master! In there… in there it's all dark, and it poured, and I fell in a gully and nearly died! And there's a ghost! One in white, with no feet, floating along, smiling at me — Third Master, you really can't go there, that's where my grandfather died!

**Ma San:** …In white?

**You:** And it eats flatbread!

**Ma San:** A ghost that eats flatbread?

**You:** Wolfs it down!

Ma San stares at you a long while. You keep shaking. You shake very professionally, head to toe; even the ends of your hair join in.

Ma San grunts and tosses the hide to the servant behind him.

Behind his father, Ma Xiaobao winks at you. "Well, well. Still alive? Tough little thing."

**You:** (head down) All thanks to you, Brother Xiaobao.

Ma Xiaobao is very pleased.

So are you.

---

When the Mas have gone, your mother pulls you into the house and shuts the door — the door has been carried back from {伴}'s vegetable patch and put up again, a little crooked.

She looks at you. For a long time.

**Mother:** That step on your father's heel just now. I saw it.

**You:** …

**Mother:** And the ghost in white with no feet that eats flatbread.

**You:** …Mother, I made that up.

**Mother:** Mm. Badly. (a pause) Ghosts don't eat flatbread. Next time say it eats incense.

She reaches out and straightens the "foxskin scarf" round your neck.

You freeze.

Inside the scarf, the unconscious little fox's ear gives the smallest twitch.

**Mother:** Nice and warm, this scarf, is it?

She asks nothing at all, and goes off to the kitchen.

exits.means: tells the truth about the ridge, lets father answer honestly

story.zh:
你爹张嘴就说了。你在后面伸脚去踩他的脚后跟——踩空了。

**爹**：（老老实实，一五一十）里头的树，比外头高一倍。鹿，比前山的大一圈。就是路不好走，下起雨来——

马三的眼睛，一下子亮了，亮得像两盏刚点上的油灯。

**马三**：大一圈？（拿短棍敲了敲你家门框，一下，一下）好。黑松岭的鹿，今年起，也姓马了。

他把鹿皮扔给了身后的家丁。

马小宝在他爹身后，冲你挤眼睛：「哟，还活着呢？命挺硬啊。」

**你**：（低头）托小宝哥的福。

马小宝很满意。

你不太满意。

---

马家的人走了以后，你娘把你拉进屋，关上门——门已经从{伴}家菜地里扛回来了，装得有点歪。

她看着你。看了很久。

**娘**：你爹那张嘴。（叹了口气）娘管了二十年，没管住。

她伸出手，替你把脖子上那条"狐皮围脖"理了理。

你愣住了。

围脖里那只昏迷的小狐狸，耳朵，轻轻动了一下。

**娘**：这条围脖，挺暖和的吧。

她什么都没问，转身去灶间了。
story.en:
Your father opens his mouth and tells it. Behind him you stick out a foot to tread on his heel — and miss.

**Father:** (honestly, every word of it) The trees in there are twice as tall as outside. The deer are a size bigger than on the front slopes. Only the paths are bad, and when it rains —

Ma San's eyes light up, bright as two oil lamps just lit.

**Ma San:** A size bigger? (rapping your door frame with his club, once, twice) Good. From this year, the deer of Black Pine Ridge are Ma deer too.

He tosses the hide to the servant behind him.

Behind his father, Ma Xiaobao winks at you. "Well, well. Still alive? Tough little thing."

**You:** (head down) All thanks to you, Brother Xiaobao.

Ma Xiaobao is very pleased.

You are not very pleased.

---

When the Mas have gone, your mother pulls you into the house and shuts the door — the door has been carried back from {伴}'s vegetable patch and put up again, a little crooked.

She looks at you. For a long time.

**Mother:** Your father's mouth. (a sigh) Twenty years I've been minding it, and I still can't.

She reaches out and straightens the "foxskin scarf" round your neck.

You freeze.

Inside the scarf, the unconscious little fox's ear gives the smallest twitch.

**Mother:** Nice and warm, this scarf, is it?

She asks nothing at all, and goes off to the kitchen.
